name: Feather Token (Whip)

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Use
powers.text: Toss it up to 10 ft: a floating whip of force attacks (+9, 1d6 + 5 Force) for up to an hour, once per Bonus Action.

summary: Toss it up to 10 ft: a floating whip of force attacks (+9, 1d6 + 5 Force) for up to an hour, once per Bonus Action.
text: A one-use token in the shape of a feather. Throw the whip token up to 10 feet and it becomes a hovering whip of force that lasts up to an hour; you can spend a Bonus Action to have it make one attack (+9 to hit, 1d6 + 5 Force damage).
